Silver nitrate solution reacts with zinc powder in an exothermic reaction:
$2AgNO_3(aq) + Zn(s) \rightarrow 2Ag(s) + Zn(NO_3)_2(aq)$
The graph shows the maximum temperature rise as different masses of zinc react with separate $50.0 \text{ cm}^3$ samples of $0.100 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ silver nitrate solution.
What is the mass of zinc at the position labelled Y?
